text:
ash: Heads-up — I'm planning a runtime change and SDK contract update for the `generation` + quota behavior today at 17:00 PT. Breaking change: we will start returning `quota_remaining` instead of `quota` and routing header `x-redwood-mode` default will flip to `cost` (was `latency`). Need a rollout plan and console/billing mapping.

omar: Wait, is this server-only? if we keep accepting `quota` in requests we can shim and avoid bumping major semver.

sophia: From eng-runtime: shim is feasible but adds ~2% CPU for parsing and mapping. I'd prefer an explicit compat toggle per org so we can remove shim later.

maya: Console dashboards expect `quota` for billing alerts. If we change the field name without mapping the dashboards will break and customers get false alarms. We need server-side mapping or console fallback.

ash: proposed rollout: canary 10% traffic @17:00 PT -> 50% after 2h -> 100% manual after 4h. Rollback conditions: 5xx > 0.5% or token_cost > 1.2x baseline. Also plan to emit telemetry indicating when we remap legacy fields.

jordan: telemetry note: emit `sdk.quota.remap` event with org_id + original_value so billing pipeline can reconcile. Add a sampling rate header to avoid volume spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @ash for 2025-07-14T00:00:00Z. Canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (manual). Link: <https://deploys.redwood.internal/1234> :rocket:

omar: SDK semantics: do we bump to 2.0.0? This is pretty noticeable to customers. If we keep the same major we risk confusion.

sophia: recommendation: ship runtime compatibility + small SDK patch bump (1.5.0) and include explicit compatibility matrix in release notes. Also add a header `x-rw-compat=1` that restores old behavior for orgs that opt-in.

maya: UX items: add a console banner for 14 days that says "Quota field is changing — migrate to `quota_remaining`" with a link to migration guide. Add per-org toggle in org settings to enable the compat shim. Also surface both fields side-by-side in the billing dashboard during migration.

ash: sample migration snippet for docs (to show mapping):

```json
// server response old -> new
{ "quota": 1200 }  // existing clients
// becomes
{ "quota_remaining": 1200 } // new field
```

or as a shim we can keep returning both for now:

```json
{ "quota": 1200, "quota_remaining": 1200 }
```

jordan: add a trace/span tag `compat.shim=1` whenever shim is used. Also increment a metric `shim.requests` per org. Billing pipeline can join on those metrics.

sophia: also change to `x-redwood-mode` default to `cost` will affect routing. Need to update routing-policy dashboard (p50/p95 changes) and adjust alert thresholds.

ash: action items: (1) eng-runtime (sophia) implement compat shim behind per-org toggle + tracing tag, (2) billing (jordan) emit `sdk.quota.remap` event and add reconciliation join keys, (3) console (maya) add banner + per-org toggle + dashboard mapping, (4) devex (omar) prepare SDK releases with clear migration snippets + changelog, (5) support get canned responses (support-bot). Rollout owner: ash. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed.

omar: +1 on changelog clarity. Suggest we also add a deprecation page with examples for common languages and a migration script for customers using SDK older than 1.4.

jordan: will update SLOs/alerts: latency-based routing -> cost-default can shift p50. I'll add new alert windows to routing-policy dashboard and run backtests on historical traffic.

sophia: I'll add a tracing tag `compat.version=1` when shim is active so we can filter traces in the trace UI.

ash: thanks everyone. I'll open a follow-up thread for the migration docs and link it here. :thumbsup:

maya: noted. please cc support so they can prepare KB and canned replies.

support-bot: @support added to thread.

ash: draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/431 (includes shim + header handling).

omar: reviewed, left one nit in README, otherwise LGTM.

ash: merging after canary starts and I'll post canary metrics here as they come in.
